relations.text: 既存顧客で利用を拡大した企業の一社にマステック
relations.text_en: Lists MasTec among existing customers that expanded with it

source.label: Sprout Social 決算発表(2024年4-6月期)
source.quote: Cintas, Porter Airlines Canada, Heidrick & Struggles International, Bausch & Lomb Americas, Auto Trader, Alterra Mountain, SentinelOne, Oliver Wyman, MasTec

relations.text: ロチェスター拠点の建設工事でマステックが未払い4,870万ドルを求め仲裁
relations.text_en: MasTec sought $48.7 million it says is owed for building the Rochester Hub

source.label: Li-Cycle 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On April 9, 2024, one of the lienors, MasTec, commenced arbitration proceedings to seek recovery of $48.7 million allegedly due under the construction contract for the Rochester Hub project

relations.text: 電力会社向け市場の競合にマステックを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names MasTec among competitors in its utilities markets

source.label: Primoris 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For example, competitors in our utilities markets include Quanta Services, Inc., Dycom Industries, MYR Group, and MasTec, Inc.

companies.name: エヴェラス・コンストラクション

relations.text: 主な競合にマステックを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names MasTec among its primary competitors

source.label: Everus Construction 10-K 添付資料(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company regards as its primary, but not exclusive, competitors the following businesses and entities, or individuals: Quanta Services, Inc., EMCOR Group, Inc., MasTec, Inc.

relations.text: 全国規模の競合にマステックを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names MasTec among its national competitors

source.label: SOLV Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our national competitors include Kiewit, MasTec, McCarthy, Mortenson, Quanta Services and Primoris Services.

relations.text: 競合にマステックを挙げる

source.label: ITG S-1(2026年6月)
source.quote: Our competitors include Dycom Industries, Inc., MasTec, Inc., Primoris Services Corporation and Quanta Services, Inc.

companies.name: マンモス・エナジー
companies.sub: インフラ・油田サービス

relations.text: インフラ事業の主な競合にマステックを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names MasTec among major competitors of its infrastructure business

source.label: Mammoth Energy 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors for our infrastructure services business include MYR Group, Inc., Quanta Services, Inc., MasTec, Inc. and EMCOR Group, Inc.

relations.text: 発電・蓄電と高圧送電の競合にマステックを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names MasTec among principal competitors in generation, storage and high-voltage transmission

source.label: CoVolt Power S-1(2026年8月)
source.quote: Our principal national competitors in high voltage transmission and distribution include Burns & McDonnell, GW, Black & Veatch, MasTec, MYR Group and Quanta Services.
